newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's PDS confident budget deal will be struck.
newsitem.headline: Italy's PDS confident budget deal will be struck.

text.p: Massimo D'Alema, leader of the Democratic Party of the Left (PDS), said he was confident government allies would strike a deal over the 1997 budget.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi is expected to unveil the package by the end of the week, but has not yet reached an agreement with the hard-left Communist Refoundation over plans to trim pension and health spending. Leaders of parties that back the centre-left government are due to meet at 1600 GMT later today to discuss the problem.
"There will be an accord," D'Alema forecast in a late night television chat show.
